title: Leadership updates
summary: OpenAI has grown a lot. We remain focused on the same core—pursuing frontier AI research that accelerates human progress–but we now also deliver products used by hundreds of millions of people.
body: OpenAI has grown a lot. We remain focused on the same core—pursuing frontier AI research that accelerates human progress–but we now also deliver products used by hundreds of millions of people.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了关于公司领导层更新的常规通告，回顾了公司在追求前沿AI研究和向全球数亿用户交付产品过程中的发展历程。

aiReview.reasonZh: 属于OpenAI内部人事与领导层更新的常规公告，与大模型技术本身无直接关联。
